note: Rural family-owned park on the south side of US 50 at St John (217 E US-50), beside the highway rest area; a shady lane, wide parking areas and an outdoor chapel. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $32 (posted now and on the Oct 2025 capture), 50 A full hookups, year-round, showers, dump, phone reservations; note trimmed of rates and the RV Life line.
flags: Gate facts (private): posted nightly $32 for 1-2 adults incl. 30 kWh/day (well under US$50; no gateway needed); not a Good Sam Park (no directory match); presence: working website with phone 620-549-3444 (stored phone confirmed); RV Life 4.5*/$$ (stored). Google Maps: 4.1 stars from 28 reviews, +1 620-549-3444, 217 E US-50, St John. Reviews not read.

Long-stay tests: (1) $32 passes; (2) nightly rate posted on its own site with a phone, no application or approval mentioned: pass; (3) no minimum stated: pass; (4) no site count on the operator's site (stored count 25 comes from earlier note prose, unsourced here; imagery shows roughly 20 rigs in two rows): passes on no count; (5) RV park, no homes or lots for sale; the site welcomes 'Traveling Tiny Homes'. Weekly $150 and monthly $500 are cheap, so some long-term occupancy is likely, but nothing posted reads as mostly long-stay. Not a drop candidate.

Pin: the stored 37.9551,-98.7084 sits in the neighbouring US-50 rest area (picnic loop and gazebo), not the park; the RV rows are ~90 m east around 37.9549,-98.7074 (Google's pin 37.955513,-98.706895 is at the park's east driveway). Optional move to 37.9549,-98.7074 (under the 250 m line).
